name: coffee-desk
description: Coffee Desk — acesso remoto P2P para Windows
author: Café - Sistemas & Softwares

scripts.build:electron: node --max-old-space-size=4096 ./node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js -p tsconfig.electron.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist-electron/main/native')) fs.mkdirSync('dist-electron/main/native', {recursive:true}); if (fs.existsSync('src/main/native/CoffeeInput.exe')) fs.copyFileSync('src/main/native/CoffeeInput.exe', 'dist-electron/main/native/CoffeeInput.exe');" && node scripts/bundle-preload.js
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && node scripts/start-electron.js"
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
